gloss: to sort; to classify; to separate into categories

definitions.gloss: to sort; to classify; to separate into categories
definitions.explanation: To divide items into groups based on type, category, or destination. Used for physical sorting (mail, laundry, garbage) and administrative categorization (budgets, accounts).

examples.japanese: ゴミを{種類|しゅるい}ごとに{仕分|しわ}ける。
{届|とど}いた{荷物|にもつ}を{配達先|はいたつさき}ごとに{仕分|しわ}けた。
examples.english: I sorted the delivered packages by destination.

examples.japanese: {予算|よさん}を{項目|こうもく}ごとに{仕分|しわ}けて、{無駄|むだ}な{支出|ししゅつ}がないか{確認|かくにん}した。
examples.english: I sorted the budget by category and checked for wasteful spending.

notes:
An ichidan (る) verb. The noun form {仕分|しわ}け is also very common, especially in compound forms.

TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive. The thing being sorted is marked with を.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ゴミを{仕分|しわ}ける: to sort garbage
- {荷物|にもつ}を{仕分|しわ}ける: to sort packages
- {予算|よさん}を{仕分|しわ}ける: to screen/sort budgets
- {郵便物|ゆうびんぶつ}を{仕分|しわ}ける: to sort mail

NOTE:
The noun form {仕分|しわ}け gained prominence in Japanese politics through the {事業|じぎょう}{仕分|しわ}け (project screening) process, where government spending programs were publicly reviewed and categorized for cutting.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {分類|ぶんるい}する: to classify — more formal and systematic; used for academic or scientific categorization
- {分|わ}ける: to divide, to separate — more general; doesn't necessarily imply categorization
- {選別|せんべつ}する: to sort out, to screen — implies selecting good from bad
